newsitem.title: USA: Quaker sees higher worldwide Gatorade sales.
newsitem.headline: Quaker sees higher worldwide Gatorade sales.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co said Wednesday it expects worldwide Gatorade sales of more than $1.5 billion this year, up from nearly $1.4 billion in 1996.
"Our worldwide Gatorade sales are expected to surpass the $1.5 billion mark this year," Quaker Chairman William Smithburg said in remarks prepared for delivery to the company's annual meeting here.

Smithburg said Quaker's sales this year will total about $5 billion, excluding Snapple, which the company has agreed to sell in a deal worth some $550 million. Quaker previously said the Snapple sale would result in a net loss of $1.1 billion.
Smithburg said about 30 percent of the company's worldwide profits come from Gatorade.
